about_short_description.short_description: CQR dedicate ourselves to providing unparalleled protection, blending proactive strategies, cutting-edge tech, and guidance.

product.name: FENNEC Platform
product.description: An OT cybersecurity platform for asset visibility, risk management, compliance tracking, threat detection, incident management, and operational reporting across critical-infrastructure environments.

product.name: Managed OT Security
product.description: A 24/7 managed OT security service providing continuous monitoring, threat detection, incident triage, compliance monitoring, escalation, and security reporting through CQR’s OT SOC and FENNEC platform.

product.name: Assessment & Compliance
product.description: Passive OT security assessments covering asset inventory, network architecture, ICS/SCADA vulnerabilities, risk exposure, and compliance gaps against NCA OTCC, IEC 62443, Aramco SAEP-99, and C2M2.

product.name: Engineering & Integration
product.description: OT security engineering for network segmentation, Purdue Model-aligned zoning, industrial firewall configuration, secure remote access, security architecture, and FENNEC integration.

product.name: Incident Response
product.description: Specialist OT incident response covering containment, ICS forensics, recovery support, post-incident hardening, tabletop exercises, and response drills for industrial environments.

product.name: Automation & Solution Integration
product.description: Secure-by-design industrial control system engineering and integration across PLC, DCS, SCADA, industrial networks, OT–enterprise connectivity, commissioning, and lifecycle support.
